args.command: echo '=== GUI TOOLS ==='; for c in chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable firefox xterm uxterm xfce4-terminal gnome-terminal alacritty kitty wmctrl xdotool openbox chatgpt; do printf '%s=' "$c"; command -v "$c" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '=== SESSION SCRIPT ==='; sed -n '1,120p' /usr/local/libexec/zen-chatgpt-session.sh 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== OPENBOX CONFIG ==='; find /var/lib/zenui/.config/openbox -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true

meta.summary: Read-only audit Mini GUI tools and current session before Control Room layout install
